name: Cold Iron Ring
desc: Iron that was never heated. Heavy on the hand.

name: Dowsing Pendulum
desc: It swings before you decide to move it.

name: Thin Brass Bell
desc: Too small to hear. Something answers it anyway.

name: Ironwood Bracer
desc: Cut from a tree that grew through a fence and kept the fence.

name: Pouch of Salt
desc: A line of it under the door. Old habit, still works.

name: Bone Rosary
desc: Someone counted their way through something on these.

name: Coil of Copper Wire
desc: Wound tight. It takes the current so you do not.

name: Hummingbird Feather
desc: Weightless, and it makes everything else you carry feel like a decision.

name: Ash Phylactery
desc: A locket of someone's ashes. It has already burned once.

name: Widow's Lens
desc: Ground from a mourning brooch. You see more and move slower.

name: Gravedigger's Gloves
desc: Stiff with work. Your hands are surer and no faster.

name: Scrying Mirror
desc: You are in it twice and you only stepped up once.

name: Serpent's Tooth
desc: Sharper than you are. It wants something in return.

name: Ferryman's Coin
desc: It was under a tongue. It is warm, and it should not be.

name: King's Signet
desc: Whoever wore it last is further down than you have been.

name: Thief's Lantern
desc: Shuttered on three sides. It shows you the floor and nothing else.
